primary_source_observations.architecture_claim: open-source modular acoustic+linguistic bimodal turn-taking detector
primary_source_observations.readme_total_wording: approximately 1,100 hours despite the listed components summing to 1,145 hours
primary_source_observations.streaming_evidence: NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_AUDITED_PRIMARY_README; published inference example is dataset/decode oriented rather than a frame-synchronous realtime contract

frankenstein_interpretation.reason: The four-state taxonomy maps unusually well to Frankenstein WAIT/backchannel/continue/respond control, but German calibration and realtime streaming behavior are unproven and the reported latency/resource footprint is much heavier than the lightweight comparator.
frankenstein_interpretation.highest_value_test_after_target_headroom: Replay the pinned German pause/backchannel/overlap corpus with a common decision mapping: complete->RESPOND, incomplete->HOLD, backchannel->KEEP_LISTENING_OR_NONINTERRUPTIVE_ACK, wait->WAIT; compare against silence/VAD, Smart Turn/DualTurn/Next-Turn/FastTurn candidates using false-interrupt rate, missed-turn rate, decision latency, and resource cost.
frankenstein_interpretation.counterhypothesis: Easy Turn's high reported state accuracy may not transfer to German and its heavier post-segment acoustic+linguistic path may add enough latency that a lighter streaming detector wins the actual Frankenstein Pareto frontier.
